statement.text:
A subset of a group is said to be rational if it can be obtained from finite
subsets by finitely many rational operations, that is, taking union, product, and the
submonoid generated by a set.
   Conjecture: every finitely generated solvable group in which all rational subsets
form a Boolean algebra is virtually abelian.
   This is known to be true if the group is metabelian, or polycyclic, or of finite rank
(G. A. Bazhenova).                                                   V. A. Roman’kov
